name: localfullpagecapture
description: Private, offline screenshot and screen-capture Chrome extension

scripts.build:e2e: wxt build --mode e2e && node scripts/strip-remote-urls.mjs dist/chrome-mv3-e2e
scripts.zip: pnpm build && cd dist/chrome-mv3 && rm -f ../LocalFullPageCapture-v$npm_package_version.zip && zip -qrX ../LocalFullPageCapture-v$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.docs:screenshots: pnpm build:e2e && DOCS=1 playwright test docs && node scripts/build-site.mjs
